decisive_spans.text: Histopathological examination demonstrated spindle cells forming masses with branching ectatic vasculature, focal collagenous regions, and up to 20 mitoses per ten high-power fields. Immunohistochemical studies showed strong immunoreactivity for CD31, CD99, and Fli-1

response.rationale: The histopathological and immunohistochemical findings strongly support Solitary fibrous tumor, which is noted to have similar features to hemangiopericytoma. The other candidates are contradicted by these findings or have less specific support.
